Read the 7 reports (2026-09-29 04:18-05:31): all fire in Swift's main-actor check at the top of the meter's run-loop observer, reading a bad executor pointer. All predate d94bc9e2 (09-29 05:55), which fixed the route that caused them: a walk closing a recording and reopening it adopted the closed editor, AppKit threw unrecognized selector at the close guard, the ObjC exception unwound through the walk's Swift task. Verified today: /tmp/ptl/close-reopen-walk.json passes on HEAD; with both halves of d94bc9e2 commented out it CRASHED again (signature moved to MenuBarArranger.start, same isMainExecutor frames). No report with the MainThreadMeter signature since 09-29 05:31.

Same mechanism found live overnight: 5 probe crashes 2026-10-02 23:35 to 2026-10-03 00:57 in MenuBarArranger.start (crash-watch had not scanned them yet). Unified log 1s before each: 'NSInvalidArgumentException: Invalid number value (NaN) in JSON write'. Source: the recording-start drill the previous runner was building wrote a NaN through JSONSerialization; try? does not catch ObjC exceptions. Reproduced on HEAD by injecting a NaN into the drill output: old writer -> 'The drill wrote nothing', CRASHED in MenuBarArranger.start; SafeJSON writer -> PASS, null in the file. HEAD's drill without the injection (sound, mic, stop-early, cancel) does not crash.

Fix: PhotonzCore SafeJSON (NaN/inf -> null, isValidJSONObject guard, never raises; 5 tests) used by every probe JSON writer (both recording drills, walk log writer which used to silently drop log.json on a NaN, grip traces, probe grants). New walk close-and-reopen-a-recording-walk (no drags, no names: runs while the person works and under a lock; timeline-dock-resizes-walk also covers reopen but needs the Mac to itself) CRASHED on a probe without d94bc9e2, ok on HEAD with 3 real captures. crash-watch: a repeat of a signature whose task is closed now files a fresh p1 naming the closed task instead of a log line nobody reads, so acceptance 3 (a week with no recurrence) is enforced after this task closes. My 3 deliberate crash reports and the 5 overnight ones are marked seen in queue/crash-watch.json, the overnight signature mapped to this task. Scripts/test.sh: 11019 passed.

The 09-29 MainThreadMeter crashes were the close-and-reopen route d94bc9e2 fixed (re-proved: crashes with it commented out, passes on HEAD); the same mechanism was live overnight as 5 MenuBarArranger crashes from a NaN in a JSON write raising an ObjC exception inside a Swift task. 85cdc27b: PhotonzCore SafeJSON (tested) for every probe JSON writer, close-and-reopen-a-recording-walk (crashes without the fix, ok with, 3 real captures, no flags), crash-watch refiles crashes whose task is closed. Scripts/test.sh 11019 passed.
